correctness.rationale: The signed permutation group has exactly 24 elements and an irreducible three-dimensional representation. Schur orthogonality gives a single Fourier block (v u^T)/3 of rank one. The proof partitions coordinate support counts (1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2),(2,3),(3,3), using symmetry to cover remaining cases. A five-edge directed-graph argument excludes 10 zeros in (2,3). A termwise alternating quartic identity excludes 5 zeros with all coordinates nonzero. Each permitted of nine sizes has an exact integer or Eisenstein witness; check_s4_support.py verifies all via current package path and 81 matrix orthogonality equations. Nonzero u,v imply nonzero coefficient by irreducibility. No finite experiment is invoked as proof of a universal exclusion.

value.rationale: The pure rank-one irreducible Fourier stratum of the rotational octahedral group is a natural nonabelian sampling object: 24 matrix coefficients and weighted dual size three. A complete nine-value support spectrum is mathematically informative beyond a lower bound; it isolates a nontrivial complex cubic-root resonance at size 21 and proves noninterval support holes strictly above the uncertainty minimum. The quartic alternation and directed-ratio obstruction explain the gaps structurally rather than through an arbitrary finite census.
